title: Roles vs Users
summary: PostgreSQL uses one object kind, the role. LOGIN and NOLOGIN decide whether a role can start a session.
learning_objectives: Explain why users and groups are both roles in PostgreSQL.
Use CREATE ROLE attributes to separate login ability from privilege grouping.
Audit a role list without assuming every role is a human user.
reflection_prompts: Which permission would you remove first if this role were leaked?
What SQL evidence would you attach to an access review?
